label: predatory bacterium
definition: A trophic-ecology lifestyle in which a bacterium actively kills and consumes other bacteria for nutrients, e.g. the periplasmic predator Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus.
observations: Existing v5 parent ID and meaning; included for standalone hierarchy.

label: epibiotic bacterial predation
definition: A predatory bacterial phenotype in which a bacterium kills and obtains nutrients from bacterial prey while attached and growing externally, without its cell body entering the prey cell.
observations: External attached feeding; predator cell body does not enter prey.
